verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented setting, opt-out, or policy that stops user data from being used to train models. The only related items are vague references to 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' and 'business plan terms' in team workspaces. Neither says training is excluded, so they are adjacent privacy claims, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
